title: soil-mtx-mgx-readbased: read-based DIAMOND + MEGAN profiling and compositional analysis of soil metatranscriptomes and metagenomes
description: Assembly-free taxonomic and functional (KEGG) profiling of Illumina soil metatranscriptomes and metagenomes with DIAMOND blastx against NCBI-nr and MEGAN Ultimate. Two per-sample Bash pipelines share all parameters that affect comparability, so RNA and DNA profiles can be compared directly. Two R Markdown analyses perform low-abundance trimming, CLR transformation, Aitchison PCA, PERMANOVA (with permutation designs for locations nested in countries), ANOSIM, PERMDISP, composition plots and DivNet alpha diversity. Includes a methods description, workflow figure, simulated test data and smoke tests.
